create_dummy_dictionary: create a fairseq Dictionary with a given vocab size and token prefix for testing
create_dummy_dataloader: create a PyTorch DataLoader from sample dicts using the fairseq collate function
train_translation_model: train a fairseq translation model on a data directory with configurable architecture and flags
train_language_model: train a fairseq language model on a data directory with configurable architecture and flags
generate_main: run fairseq generation on a checkpoint in batch and interactive mode with configurable beam size
